description: This Java class implements the strategy for handling 'ModifyAttribute' commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework, specifically for modifying or creating attributes of 'Thing' entities, including size validation and event generation.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractThingCommandStrategy to handle 'ModifyAttribute' commands, including logic for modifying or creating attributes, size validation, and event generation.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command to modify or create an attribute on a 'Thing', performing size validation and returning the appropriate event result.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Creates a result indicating an attribute was modified, including event and response generation.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Creates a result indicating a new attribute was created, including event and response generation.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the previous entity tag for the attribute, if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next entity tag based on the new attribute value.
